title: MOTORSLICE

Not verified by the maintainer. theeirdna-commits (highball-db#1245, 2026-11-15), Apple M1, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 27 minutes: the same player, a 60 fps cap, fullscreen at 1440x900 and the lowest settings, 50 fps standing still and 30 to 40 when moving or attacking.
notes: Regular Studio's 2026 game. Reported playable twice by one player on a base M1 with macOS 15.7.7 and DXMT at the lowest settings, about 50 fps standing still and 30 to 40 when moving or attacking, on the default engine (r28) over 8 minutes and on the Wine 11 engine r31 over 27 minutes (highball-db#1237, highball-db#1245).
